<style id="weflair-cal-widget-overrides">
    .weflair-hero-widget-wrap {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-end;
      justify-content: flex-end;
      min-height: 1px
    }

    .weflair-audit-widget {
      position: fixed !important;
      right: clamp(.9rem, 2vw, 1.4rem) !important;
      bottom: clamp(.9rem, 2vw, 1.4rem) !important;
      z-index: 70 !important;
      width: min(calc(100vw - 1.8rem), 22rem) !important;
      margin-left: 0 !important;
      transition: opacity .24s ease, transform .24s ease, visibility .24s ease !important
    }

    .weflair-audit-widget__launcher {
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 4.25rem !important;
      height: 4.25rem !important;
      margin-left: auto;
      border: 1px solid rgba(246, 243, 238, .12) !important;
      border-radius: 999px !important;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(18, 19, 18, .96) 0%, rgba(12, 13, 12, .98) 100%) !important;
      color: #f6f3ee;
      box-shadow: 0 16px 36px rgba(0, 0, 0, .32) !important;
      cursor: pointer
    }

    .weflair-audit-widget__panel {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
      gap: 1rem;
      padding: 1.05rem 1.05rem 1.1rem !important;
      border: 1px solid rgba(246, 243, 238, .08) !important;
      border-radius: 1.25rem !important;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(17, 17, 17, .96) 0%, rgba(11, 12, 11, .98) 100%) !important;
      box-shadow: 0 22px 48px rgba(0, 0, 0, .34) !important
    }

    .weflair-audit-widget__head {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
      align-items: flex-start;
      column-gap: .8rem;
      width: 100%;
      min-width: 0
    }

    .weflair-audit-widget.is-collapsed .weflair-audit-widget__panel {
      display: none !important
    }

    .weflair-audit-widget:not(.is-collapsed) .weflair-audit-widget__launcher {
      display: none !important
    }

    .weflair-audit-widget__profile {
      min-width: 0
    }

    .weflair-audit-widget__close {
      flex: 0 0 auto;
      justify-self: end
    }

    .weflair-audit-widget__eyebrow {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: .35rem;
      padding: .34rem .62rem;
      border: 1px solid rgba(62, 255, 104, .18);
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: rgba(62, 255, 104, .08);
      font-size: .72rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: .06em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: #9dffb6
    }

    .weflair-audit-widget__title {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: 1.72rem !important;
      line-height: .98 !important;
      letter-spacing: -.05em !important;
      text-wrap: balance
    }

    .weflair-audit-widget__body {
      margin: 0;
      color: rgba(246, 243, 238, .82);
      font-size: .95rem !important;
      line-height: 1.46 !important
    }

    .weflair-audit-widget__proof {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: .45rem
    }

    .weflair-audit-widget__proof-pill {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      min-height: 1.95rem;
      padding: .35rem .62rem;
      border: 1px solid rgba(246, 243, 238, .08);
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: rgba(23, 24, 23, .96);
      font-size: .76rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1;
      color: rgba(246, 243, 238, .88)
    }

    .weflair-audit-widget__list {
      display: grid;
      gap: .55rem;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none
    }

    .weflair-audit-widget__list li {
      position: relative;
      padding-left: 1.15rem;
      color: rgba(246, 243, 238, .76);
      font-size: .84rem;
      line-height: 1.45
    }

    .weflair-audit-widget__list li::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      left: 0;
      top: .46rem;
      width: .42rem;
      height: .42rem;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: #3eff68;
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 .18rem rgba(62, 255, 104, .12)
    }

    .weflair-audit-widget__cta .btn {
      width: 100%
    }

    .weflair-audit-widget__foot {
      font-size: .77rem;
      line-height: 1.3;
      color: rgba(246, 243, 238, .48);
      text-align: center
    }

    @media (max-width: 991px) {
      .weflair-audit-widget {
        width: min(calc(100vw - 1.6rem), 20rem) !important
      }

      body[data-navigation-status="active"] .weflair-audit-widget {
        opacity: 0 !important;
        visibility: hidden !important;
        pointer-events: none !important;
        transform: translateY(.75rem) !important
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 767px) {
      .weflair-audit-widget {
        right: .8rem !important;
        bottom: .8rem !important;
        width: min(calc(100vw - 1.6rem), 22rem) !important
      }
    }

    /* --- PLAYBOOKS SECTION ----------------------------------------------- */
    .weflair-playbooks {
      padding: var(--section-padding, 6rem) 0;
      display: none !important;
    }

    .weflair-playbooks .weflair-section__head {
      justify-items: center;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .weflair-playbooks .weflair-section__head .h3 {
      max-width: 18ch;
    }

    .weflair-playbooks .weflair-section__body {
      text-align: center;
    }

    .weflair-playbooks-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: .7rem;
      margin-top: 2.8rem;
    }

    .weflair-playbook-card {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 1rem;
      padding: 1.35rem 1.25rem 1.15rem;
      border: 1px solid rgba(246, 243, 238, .08);
      border-radius: 1.2rem;
      background: rgba(17, 17, 17, .86);
      transition: border-color .22s, background .22s;
    }

    .weflair-playbook-card:hover {
      border-color: rgba(62, 255, 104, .22);
      background: rgba(17, 17, 17, .96);
    }

    .weflair-playbook-card__icon {
      width: 2.4rem;
      height: 2.4rem;
      border-radius: .65rem;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .weflair-playbook-card__icon svg {
      width: 1.15rem;
      height: 1.15rem;
    }

    .weflair-playbook-card__body {
      flex: 1;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: .5rem;
    }

    .weflair-playbook-card__title {
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #f6f3ee;
      letter-spacing: -.02em;
      margin: 0;
    }

    .weflair-playbook-card__desc {
      font-size: .84rem;
      color: rgba(246, 243, 238, .58);
      line-height: 1.52;
      margin: 0;
    }

    .weflair-playbook-card__tag {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      padding: .22rem .58rem;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(246, 243, 238, .1);
      font-size: .65rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: .06em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: rgba(246, 243, 238, .38);
      width: fit-content;
    }

    .weflair-playbook-card__btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: .4rem;
      margin-top: auto;
      padding-top: 1rem;
      padding: .45rem .9rem .45rem .75rem;
      border-radius: .5rem;
      border: 1px solid rgba(62, 255, 104, .22);
      background: rgba(62, 255, 104, .07);
      font-family: inherit;
      font-size: .72rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: .04em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: #3eff68;
      cursor: pointer;
      text-decoration: none;
      transition: background .18s, border-color .18s;
      width: fit-content;
      margin-top: auto;
    }

    .weflair-playbook-card__btn:hover {
      background: rgba(62, 255, 104, .13);
      border-color: rgba(62, 255, 104, .38);
    }

    .weflair-playbook-card__btn svg {
      width: .85rem;
      height: .85rem;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .weflair-playbooks-footer {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      margin-top: 2.5rem;
    }

    @media (max-width: 991px) {
      .weflair-playbooks-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 640px) {
      .weflair-playbooks-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
    }
  </style>
<style id="weflair-new-sections-css">
      /* --- WHY WEFLAIR + CREDENTIALS --- */
      .weflair-why-us {
        --why-bg: linear-gradient(180deg, #f6f1e7 0%, #fcfaf6 100%);
        --why-text: #1b2635;
        --why-text-soft: rgba(27, 38, 53, .72);
        --why-line: rgba(27, 38, 53, .12);
        --why-surface: rgba(255, 255, 255, .74);
        --why-surface-strong: rgba(255, 255, 255, .9);
        --why-shadow: 0 18px 42px rgba(47, 35, 22, .08);
        --why-navy: #445376;
        --why-navy-deep: #2d3957;
        --why-data: #7fe070;
        --why-data-deep: #2d5b34;
        --why-board: #171c22;
        --why-board-soft: rgba(23, 28, 34, .78);
        --why-cta-bg: #1b2635;
        --why-cta-text: #f9f6ef;
        padding: clamp(6.25rem, 8vw, 8rem) 0;
        background: var(--why-bg);
        color: var(--why-text);
        overflow: clip
      }

      .weflair-why-us .container { max-width: 90rem }

      .weflair-why-us__intro {
        width: min(100%, 76rem);
        max-width: none;
        margin: 0 auto;
        text-align: left
      }

      .weflair-why-us .eyebrow.is-centered {
        justify-content: flex-start;
        margin-bottom: .35rem
      }

      .weflair-why-us .eyebrow__p,
      .weflair-why-us .h3,
      .weflair-why-us .weflair-section__body,
      .weflair-why-us .weflair-why-us__cred-title { color: var(--why-text) }

      .weflair-why-us .h3 {
        max-width: 11.2ch;
        margin: 0;
        font-size: clamp(2.65rem, 4.8vw, 4.75rem);
        line-height: .95;
        letter-spacing: -.075em;
        text-wrap: balance
      }

      .weflair-why-us .weflair-section__body {
        max-width: 42rem;
        margin: 0;
        color: var(--why-text-soft);
        text-wrap: pretty
      }

      .weflair-why-us__stories {
        max-width: 80rem;
        margin: clamp(3rem, 4vw, 4rem) auto 0;
        display: grid;
        gap: clamp(2.8rem, 4vw, 4rem)
      }

      .weflair-why-us__story {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, .96fr) minmax(24rem, 1.12fr);
        gap: clamp(2.5rem, 4vw, 4.25rem);
        align-items: center
      }

      .weflair-why-us__copy {
        max-width: 29rem
      }

      .weflair-why-us__index {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: .8rem;
        margin-bottom: 1rem;
        color: #22c55e;
        font-size: .84rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: .18em;
        text-transform: uppercase
      }

      .weflair-why-us__index::after {
        content: '';
        width: 6.25rem;
        height: 1px;
        background: #22c55e
      }

      .weflair-why-us__copy h3 {
        margin: 0;
        font-size: clamp(2.1rem, 3.2vw, 3.35rem);
        line-height: .97;
        letter-spacing: -.065em;
        color: var(--why-text);
        text-wrap: balance
      }

      .weflair-why-us__copy p {
        margin: 1.15rem 0 0;
        font-size: 1.05rem;
        line-height: 1.7;
        color: var(--why-text-soft);
        text-wrap: pretty
      }

      .weflair-why-us__visual {
        position: relative;
        min-height: 31rem;
        border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .65);
        border-radius: 2rem;
        background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, .92) 0%, rgba(250, 247, 241, .84) 100%);
        box-shadow: var(--why-shadow);
        padding: 1.5rem
      }

      .weflair-why-us__visual::before {
        content: '';
        position: absolute;
        inset: 1rem;
        border-radius: 1.45rem;
        border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .45);
        pointer-events: none
      }

      .weflair-why-us__visual--loops {
        background:
          radial-gradient(circle at 82% 26%, rgba(114, 143, 201, .08), transparent 27%),
          radial-gradient(circle at 16% 72%, rgba(109, 163, 124, .08), transparent 22%),
          linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.92) 0%, rgba(244,239,232,.86) 100%)
      }

      .weflair-why-us__visual--team {
        background:
          radial-gradient(circle at 84% 20%, rgba(136, 155, 217, .12), transparent 24%),
          linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(236, 241, 253, .92) 0%, rgba(230, 236, 247, .84) 100%)
      }

      .weflair-why-us__visual--data {
        background:
          radial-gradient(circle at 82% 26%, rgba(128, 224, 112, .18), transparent 24%),
          linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(233, 252, 224, .96) 0%, rgba(207, 246, 184, .88) 100%)
      }

      .weflair-why-us__visual-shell {
        position: relative;
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        min-height: 28rem;
        border-radius: 1.45rem
      }

      .why-loop-board {
        position: relative;
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        min-height: 0;
        background: transparent;
        box-shadow: none;
        border-radius: inherit;
        overflow: hidden;
        display: block;
        padding: 0;
      }

      .weflair-why-us__visual--loops {
        padding: 0 !important;
        overflow: hidden;
        min-height: 0 !important;
      }

      .weflair-why-us__visual--loops::before {
        display: none !important;
      }

      .weflair-why-us__visual--loops .weflair-why-us__visual-shell {
        min-height: 0;
        border-radius: inherit;
        overflow: hidden;
      }

      .why-loop-image {
        display: block;
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        max-width: 100%;
        margin: 0;
        border-radius: inherit;
        object-fit: cover;
        object-position: center 52%;
        transform: scale(1.15) translate(3%, 2%);
        transform-origin: center;
      }

      .why-loop-board::before {
        content: '';
        position: absolute;
        inset: .95rem .95rem auto;
        height: .38rem;
        width: .38rem;
        border-radius: 999px;
        background: rgba(255,255,255,.22);
        box-shadow: .85rem 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,.16), 1.7rem 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,.1)
      }

      .why-loop-board::after {
        content: '';
        position: absolute;
        inset: .8rem;
        border-radius: 1.18rem;
        border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);
        pointer-events: none
      }

      .why-loop-canvas {
        position: relative;
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.06fr) minmax(12.75rem, .84fr);
        align-items: center;
        gap: 1.1rem;
        height: 100%;
        min-height: 28rem;
        padding: 3.2rem 1.7rem 1.55rem
      }

      .why-loop-funnel {
        position: relative;
        display: grid;
        align-content: center;
        gap: .15rem;
        min-height: 23rem;
        padding: 1.95rem 1.25rem 1.1rem 1.55rem;
        clip-path: polygon(9% 0, 100% 0, 82% 100%, 0 100%);
        background:
          linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(17, 87, 64, .44) 0%, rgba(8, 41, 32, .94) 100%);
        border: 1px solid rgba(118, 189, 146, .16);
        border-radius: 1.15rem;
        box-shadow:
          inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.05),
          0 18px 36px rgba(2, 8, 10, .18)
      }

      .why-loop-funnel::before {
        content: '';
        position: absolute;
        inset: .82rem;
        border-radius: .95rem;
        border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05);
        opacity: .9;
        pointer-events: none
      }

      .why-loop-funnel::after {
        content: '';
        position: absolute;
        inset: 1.4rem 1.25rem 1.2rem 1.45rem;
        background:
          linear-gradient(rgba(225, 240, 199, .07) 1px, transparent 1px) 0 0 / 100% 4.15rem;
        opacity: .9;
        pointer-events: none
      }

      .why-loop-step {
        position: relative;
        z-index: 1;
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
        gap: .8rem;
        align-items: center;
        min-height: 3.75rem;
        padding: 0 0 0 .1rem
      }

      .why-loop-stage {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        min-height: 3.75rem;
        padding: .2rem .35rem .2rem 0;
        color: rgba(247, 247, 243, .95);
        font-size: 1.03rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        line-height: 1.02;
        letter-spacing: -.04em
      }

      .why-loop-pill {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        min-width: 5.55rem;
        padding: .44rem .78rem;
        border-radius: 999px;
        background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(212, 244, 76, .98) 0%, rgba(194, 231, 58, .92) 100%);
        color: #172111;
        font-size: .67rem;
        font-weight: 800;
        letter-spacing: .04em;
        box-shadow:
          0 .45rem 1rem rgba(144, 181, 33, .14),
          inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.28)
      }

      .why-loop-orbit {
        position: relative;
        display: grid;
        place-items: center;
        min-height: 23rem
      }

      .why-loop-ring {
        position: relative;
        width: 12.75rem;
        height: 12.75rem;
        border: .98rem solid rgba(173, 210, 47, .8);
        border-left-color: transparent;
        border-radius: 999px;
        transform: rotate(-18deg);
        filter: drop-shadow(0 18px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.16))
      }

      .why-loop-ring::before,
      .why-loop-ring::after {
        content: '';
        position: absolute;
        width: 0;
        height: 0;
        border-style: solid
      }

      .why-loop-ring::before {
        top: -.55rem;
        right: 2rem;
        border-width: 1rem 0 .55rem 1.45rem;
        border-color: transparent transparent transparent rgba(173, 210, 47, .88)
      }

      .why-loop-ring::after {
        bottom: -.55rem;
        left: 1.8rem;
        border-width: .55rem 1.45rem 1rem 0;
        border-color: transparent rgba(173, 210, 47, .88) transparent transparent
      }

      .why-loop-label {
        position: absolute;
        inset: 61% auto auto 43%;
        transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
        padding: .92rem 1.05rem .95rem;
        border-radius: .98rem;
        background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(18, 51, 43, .88) 0%, rgba(16, 40, 34, .96) 100%);
        border: 1px solid rgba(168, 205, 91, .18);
        color: rgba(247, 247, 243, .94);
        font-size: 1.18rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        line-height: 1.1;
        letter-spacing: -.04em;
        text-align: center;
        backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
        box-shadow:
          0 1rem 2rem rgba(2, 8, 6, .28),
          inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.05)
      }

      .why-team-scene {
        position: relative;
        height: 100%;
        min-height: 28rem;
        padding: 2.6rem 1.2rem 1.2rem;
        border-radius: 1.45rem
      }

      .why-team-grid {
        position: absolute;
        inset: 1rem;
        border-radius: 1.2rem;
        background:
          linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.32) 1px, transparent 1px) 0 0 / 100% 5.4rem,
          linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,.22) 1px, transparent 1px) 0 0 / 6.2rem 100%;
        opacity: .34
      }

      .why-team-stack {
        position: relative;
        z-index: 1;
        display: grid;
        gap: .85rem;
        max-width: 27rem
      }

      .why-team-row {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: .9rem;
        padding: .9rem 1rem;
        border-radius: 1.05rem;
        background: rgba(255,255,255,.78);
        border: 1px solid rgba(66, 82, 108, .12);
        box-shadow: 0 14px 22px rgba(68, 83, 118, .12);
        animation: whyLiftIn .7s ease both
      }

      .why-team-row.is-lead {
        background: linear-gradient(180deg, #445376 0%, #39496d 100%);
        color: #f7f7f3
      }

      .why-team-row.is-muted {
        opacity: .42;
        background: rgba(255,255,255,.4)
      }

      .why-team-row:nth-child(2) { margin-left: 1.9rem; animation-delay: .08s }
      .why-team-row:nth-child(3) { margin-left: 3.2rem; animation-delay: .16s }
      .why-team-row:nth-child(4) { margin-top: .85rem; animation-delay: .22s }
      .why-team-row:nth-child(5) { margin-left: 1.9rem; animation-delay: .3s }

      .why-team-avatar {
        width: 3rem;
        height: 3rem;
        border-radius: .9rem;
        overflow: hidden;
        flex: 0 0 3rem;
        background: rgba(255,255,255,.12)
      }

      .why-team-avatar img {
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        object-fit: cover
      }

      .why-team-meta {
        display: grid;
        gap: .18rem
      }

      .why-team-name {
        font-size: 1rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        line-height: 1.08;
        letter-spacing: -.02em
      }

      .why-team-role {
        font-size: .84rem;
        line-height: 1.35;
        color: rgba(27, 38, 53, .62)
      }

      .why-team-row.is-lead .why-team-role {
        color: rgba(247,247,243,.72)
      }

      .why-team-checklist {
        position: absolute;
        right: 1.2rem;
        top: 4.1rem;
        z-index: 2;
        width: min(15rem, 44%);
        padding: 1.25rem 1.2rem;
        border-radius: 1.1rem;
        background: rgba(255,255,255,.82);
        border: 1px solid rgba(66,82,108,.12);
        box-shadow: 0 20px 35px rgba(68,83,118,.16);
        backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
